tagline: Win or bleed, the clock ticks either way — and the moon falls on everyone

featuredCards.title: Countdown
featuredCards.caption: A free action with a dare attached: they can run three spaces, but if they end up out of reach the clock loses a token. Stay and fight, or flee and hurry the end.

featuredCards.title: Majora's Flame
featuredCards.caption: The bread-and-butter swing. Three copies, boostable, and every combat you win pulls another token off the tower.

featuredCards.title: Majora's Wrath
featuredCards.caption: Losing feeds the clock too. Every 2 damage you eat behind this block ticks the tower — there is no safe way to hit Skull Kid.

featuredCards.title: Final Hour
featuredCards.caption: The cash-out. Value grows by one for every token gone, so the same card that blocks for 2 on turn one blocks for 7 when the moon is falling.
